subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 13, 2026
body:
**October 13, 2026 AcreetionOS Newsletter**

**Top Development:**

AcreetionOS has been featured in BetaNews as an "easy-to-use alternative to Windows 10/11"! In the article, "It just works": AcreetionOS is the easy-to-use alternative to Windows 10/11, the author highlights the user-friendly interface and seamless experience of AcreetionOS, making it an attractive option for those looking to switch from Windows. Read the full article here: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxNUmphYndQSENLb0V6RjNLUlgzTTNfa2FwcnRmNUcwYmNYc0VJd1NNWjl1U1N0UXFmMTU4SWpGZGQ4T09ISFYwbWgzOWN6cERUZURLNXIxUi1uM3VTbU9yQkV1eVVkU0xTdzBpUEZ

**Community News:**

The AcreetionOS community is thriving! Our Discord server is bustling with activity, and we're excited to see new users joining the conversation. If you're interested in getting involved, head over to https://discord.acreetionos.org to connect with the community.

**Practical Tip:**

Did you know that you can easily install AcreetionOS on a USB drive using our AcreetionMediaWriter tool? Simply download the tool from our website, follow the instructions, and you'll have a bootable AcreetionOS USB drive in no time! This is a great way to try out AcreetionOS without affecting your main system.
